summary: Living area is well-lit with potential tip hazards on the sideboard.

hazards.title: Unanchored Sideboard Console
hazards.detail: Large credenza can tip if climbed on or pulled, posing a crush hazard.
fixSteps: Locate wall studs directly behind the console table.
Install heavy-duty anti-tip furniture straps to wall studs.

hazards.title: Unsecured Heavy Table Lamp
hazards.detail: Tall ceramic table lamp can easily be bumped or knocked over.
fixSteps: Apply museum putty under the base to resist bumps.
Ensure the power cord is tucked safely behind the cabinet.

hazards.title: Unsecured Secondary Table Lamp
hazards.detail: Right table lamp can tip off the edge if jostled or pulled by cord.
fixSteps: Secure lamp base with quake putty or adhesive pads.
Route cords snugly behind furniture away from walkways.

products.name: Anti-Tip Furniture Straps
products.reason: Anchors the credenza securely to wall studs to prevent tip-over.
products.searchQuery: heavy duty anti-tip furniture wall straps

products.name: Museum Putty Adhesive
products.reason: Stabilizes tabletop lamps and decor from accidental knocks.
